purpose: Adapt action to facts, conditions, or actual needs.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
N + に即して / に即した + N
Support suited to the actual circumstances is needed.
We will revise the plan in line with feedback from the site.
Please explain it in keeping with the facts.
formation: N + に即して / に即した + N
restrictions: Typically with 現実, 実情, 状況, and needs.
mistake: For following an established rule as a norm, に則って is more specific.
